cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Power, More Problems
cards.instruction: Celebrate every burden, restriction, or crisis as evidence that your influence is expanding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Three more departments to cover! I'll coordinate the whole stretch. My influence is spreading.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No extra budget. You'll have to borrow their meeting rooms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, a presence everywhere. I'll fit around their bookings and bring my own chairs if that keeps everyone working together.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll find a trolley for your files. Your desk is going to the new receptionist.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: A mobile headquarters! I'll wheel it out of her way before she arrives. Could you leave a corner for it near each department? Even my parking arrangements now cross the organization.

heightening.evidence: A5 turns needing corners to park a file trolley into proof even A parking reaches across the organization.
